test_list.description: ui.theme keeps its existing meaning while ui.cli.theme parses separately.
CLI preferences use stable defaults and reject invalid enum values or types.
Updating one ui.cli field preserves unrelated known and unknown TOML values.
A failed update leaves the existing configuration bytes unchanged.
Saving one field does not replace sibling ui.cli preferences.
Saving an unedited selected row performs no write even when a CLI runtime override supplies its effective value.
Cycling a setting marks only that field as an explicit edit; saving it does not persist sibling CLI overrides.
